description: 📍 Checkmyguest offers this superb air-conditioned apartment, ideally located on Avenue de Wagram, just minutes from Parc Monceau, the Arc de Triomphe, and the Champs-Élysées. Completely renovated with high-end materials, it offers an elegant and peaceful setting, within easy reach of shops, restaurants, and public transport, allowing you to experience Paris with complete serenity.The space⭐ Located on the 3sd floor of a classic Parisian building with elevator access, this 180 sqm apartment has been entirely redesigned by an architect to offer a truly unique stay in the heart of the 17th arrondissement, just steps from Avenue des Ternes and the Arc de Triomphe.Every space has been carefully optimized to combine comfort, functionality, and elegance, creating a warm and inviting interior. The renovation features high-end materials and custom-made woodwork in mango wood, walnut, and oak, adding character, refinement, and warmth.The result is a chic, modern, and thoughtfully designed apartment, ideal for accommodating up to 10 guests in a sophisticated yet cozy setting.A true Parisian cocoon where design and comfort come together for an exceptional stay.📍 Ideally located on Avenue de Wagram, the apartment enjoys a quiet, residential environment while being just steps away from shops, restaurants, and cafés. You’ll also be close to some of Paris’s most iconic landmarks, such as the Arc de Triomphe, Parc Monceau, and the Champs-Élysées, with numerous metro stations and bus lines nearby, making it easy to explore the entire city.⭐ A space designed for your comfort:✔️ A spacious, bright living room with sofas, TV and Netflix, opening onto a fully equipped, functional kitchen with coffee machine, kettle, oven, microwave, refrigerator, toaster, dishwasher, washer-dryer, and a dini
